sections.why: The section's own reconciliation note says the only legacy figures found in the pool are $139/$279/$699 (per the Appendix source map). But the 'Plan Tiers' and 'Monthly Add-On Pricing' subsections then assert brand-new numbers — Starter 'from $99', Premium 'from $999', and white label/integrations/user add-ons at $299/$299/$15 — labeled 'canonical, per redo instruction' with NO source citation and no ⚑ flag. This contradicts the doc's own admission that only $139/$279/$699 were traceable, and reads as invented specifics dressed up as resolved facts.
sections.redo: For the Plan Tiers table and the Monthly Add-On Pricing block: either (a) cite the actual facts-pool page each new number ($99, $999, $299, $299, $15) traces to, or (b) if no such page exists, mark them ⚑ HUMAN DECISION exactly like every other unverified figure in this draft, instead of labeling them 'canonical.' Do not resolve a pricing conflict by asserting a number that isn't in the source list.
